name: Positivity
overview: Scripture teaches that true positivity is rooted in a life aligned with God's ways, as seen in the blessings promised to those who avoid ungodly counsel and walk in the law of the Lord. Trusting fully in God rather than relying on our own understanding fosters a hopeful and thankful heart. Seeking God's kingdom first brings assurance that our needs will be met, while a spirit of continual gratitude and prayer sustains peace and confidence in all circumstances.
